findings.title: Verify-only accepts a future serve schema that restore-into refuses
findings.evidence: Handler fixture I4_verify exit 0 with schema=kizuki.backup/v3 complete=true; I4_restore exit 1 error: backup serve schema 9 is newer than 8. invocation-receipts.json.
findings.invariant: Public verify should not report success for a backup the same binary cannot restore.
findings.fix: Apply the running serve (and any live ledger) ceiling in verifyBackup, or document verify as hash/completeness only. P015 owns export/restore implementation.

findings.title: --verify does not prevent writes when --into is present
findings.evidence: Flag parsed and never read. A9 restored into /work/out/run/verify-into with vault= and count lines.
findings.invariant: Dry/preview vs write should be one obvious dispatch.
findings.fix: Either ignore --verify in usage when --into is set, or refuse the combination. Docs (P006) currently treat --verify as equivalent to omitted --into.

findings.title: restore --json is an unknown option
findings.evidence: A6 exit 2, stderr error: unknown option --json.
findings.invariant: Documented JSON envelope must match implemented verbs.
findings.fix: P006: limit the intro to verbs that implement --json, or P028 adds restore JSON if that contract is wanted.

findings.title: Occupied restore target uses export error wording
findings.evidence: P3 stderr error: export output directory is not empty: /work/out/run/occupied
findings.invariant: Failure text should name the restore destination.
findings.fix: P015: restore-specific message. Core occupied-target test already exists; do not duplicate.

findings.title: CLI public restore outcomes are mostly untested
findings.evidence: e2e asserts only verified= and vault= plus .kizuki exists. No CLI test for usage, incompatible envelopes, counts, or warning= lines. Core library tests already cover ledger allowlist and occupied targets.
findings.invariant: Public command stdout/stderr/exit codes need CLI-seam tests.
findings.fix: P028: add CLI tests from /work/out fixtures; do not retest agent-enrollment-backup ledger allowlist.
